step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates DISH Network's automated account and network provisioning workflow across multi-account environments (Root, Vended, Network). First, internal users trigger an automated workflow in their ITSM tool. Once approved, the ITSM tool triggers AWS Control Tower in the Root account to provision a new vended AWS account with baseline configurations. Next, AWS Service Catalog in the Root account provisions a VPC in the new Vended account. Finally, the Transit Gateway in the Vended account connects to the central Transit Gateway in the Network account to establish network connectivity across accounts.

graph.name: DISH Network Automated Multi-Account and Network Provisioning Architecture
graph.notes: DISH Network uses an ITSM tool integrated with AWS Control Tower and AWS Service Catalog to automate account vending and Transit Gateway network connectivity across hundreds of AWS accounts.
